```{r}
#| label: outsourcing-comparison
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
source(here::here("resources/viz-setup.R"))

load_data <- tibble(
  scenario = factor(
    c(
      rep("Gutes Design\n(ohne KI)", 3),
      rep("KI-Outsourcing", 3)
    ),
    levels = c("Gutes Design\n(ohne KI)", "KI-Outsourcing")
  ),
  load_type = factor(
    rep(c("Extrinsische Last", "Intrinsische Last", "Lernrelevante\nVerarbeitung"), 2),
    levels = c("Lernrelevante\nVerarbeitung", "Intrinsische Last", "Extrinsische Last")
  ),
  value = c(
    15, 35, 50,   # Gutes Design
    5, 10, 0      # KI-Outsourcing
  ),
  fill_color = rep(c(color_neutral, color_attention, color_positive), 2)
)

# Add unused capacity for outsourcing
unused <- tibble(
  scenario = factor("KI-Outsourcing", levels = c("Gutes Design\n(ohne KI)", "KI-Outsourcing")),
  load_type = factor("Ungenutzte Kapazität",
    levels = c("Ungenutzte Kapazität", "Lernrelevante\nVerarbeitung", "Intrinsische Last", "Extrinsische Last")),
  value = 85,
  fill_color = "#e5e7eb"
)

load_data <- load_data |>
  mutate(load_type = factor(load_type,
    levels = c("Ungenutzte Kapazität", "Lernrelevante\nVerarbeitung", "Intrinsische Last", "Extrinsische Last")))

all_data <- bind_rows(load_data, unused)

fill_colors <- c(
  "Extrinsische Last" = color_neutral,
  "Intrinsische Last" = color_attention,
  "Lernrelevante\nVerarbeitung" = color_positive,
  "Ungenutzte Kapazität" = "#e5e7eb"
)

ggplot(all_data, aes(x = scenario, y = value, fill = load_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.4, y = 100, label = "Arbeitsgedächtnis-Kapazität",
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.2, color = color_neutral, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = fill_colors,
    name = NULL,
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 110),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = paste0(seq(0, 100, 25), "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Was KI-Outsourcing mit der kognitiven Belastung macht",
    subtitle = "Outsourcing eliminiert die lernrelevante Verarbeitung, statt nur die extrinsische Last zu reduzieren",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Anteil der Arbeitsgedächtnis-Kapazität"
  ) +
  theme_workshop() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", lineheight = 1.1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```
